author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Statistics item validation depends on the app navigation module for a route segment policy that already exists in shared utilities.
findings.consequence: This couples backend response validation to the broader internal-navigation module and leaves the same route-segment rule maintained in two places, increasing drift risk if one copy changes.
findings.evidence: Line 12 calls validRouteSegment imported from app/lib/internal-navigation.ts. The same policy is also implemented and tested in shared/utils/route-segment.ts: length, trim, dot segment, slash, percent, control, and lone-surrogate checks match the internal-navigation implementation.
findings.recommendation: Import validRouteSegment from #shared/utils/route-segment, or have internal-navigation re-export that shared implementation, so statistics validation and route validation use one policy source.
